problem:
Several children were asked their age. The age of each child (in years) was recorded below. If $X$ is the age of a randomly selected child, what is the expected value of $X?$

| Age | $10$ | $11$ | $12$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Number of Children | $2$ | $4$ | $4$ |
worked_solution:
The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

We're given the frequencies of the children's ages, so we can start by computing the corresponding probabilities. The total number of children is $2+4+4=10,$ so the corresponding probabilities are as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X=10)=f(10) & =\frac{2}{10}=\frac{1}{5} \\ P(X=11)=f(11) & =\frac{4}{10}=\frac{2}{5} \\ P(X=12)=f(12) & =\frac{4}{10}=\frac{2}{5}\end{aligned}
$$

We organize these results in the table below.

| $x$ | $10$ | $11$ | $12$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $\frac{1}{5}$ | $\frac{2}{5}$ | $\frac{2}{5}$ |

Now, summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =10\cdot f(10)+11\cdot f(11)+12\cdot f(12) \\  & =10(\frac{1}{5})+11(\frac{2}{5})+12(\frac{2}{5}) \\  & =2+\frac{22}{5}+\frac{24}{5} \\  & =\frac{10}{5}+\frac{22}{5}+\frac{24}{5} \\  & =\frac{10+22+24}{5} \\  & =\frac{56}{5} \\  & =11.2.\end{aligned}
$$
